scope: Historical CPU Vulkan scene receipts and fixes from 2026-10-07. Subsequent physical GPU acceptance is recorded separately in hardware_acceptance; these scene receipts remain software diagnostics.
working_tree: pre-existing uncommitted work preserved; runtime and shader identities recorded per run
limits: Five initial clean scenes plus affected scenes regenerated after fixes; hashes distinguish tested builds.
Mantis phase is prepared from a source-derived memory card; no continuous campaign proof.
Ordinary startup/savestate reanchors are reported; absence of fallback guards is not a pixel-by-pixel visual oracle.
Fast/paced texture comparison checks live DG_TEXTURE metadata, not every VRAM pixel or all resource classes.
Old incomplete states need an original reload; no retroactive snapshot repair.
Performance and packaging acceptance on a physical SteamOS/GPU/display/controller remain pending.
The glslc -O0 portability workaround still needs physical GPU timing.

hardware_acceptance.scope: Eight short scenes at true 4K, 21 GPU integration cases and eight save/restore cycles. Other GPUs, final packages and full campaign visual acceptance remain unverified.
